# GeoTagHQ

GeoTagHQ is a free online geo tagging tool for adding GPS coordinates and local SEO metadata to photos.

## Main Tool
/free-geo-tagging-tool

## Features
- Add GPS coordinates to photos
- Select real map locations
- Edit local SEO metadata
- Add title, description, keywords, business name, service, city, district and country
- Generate suggested alt text
- Download optimized images

## Important Note
Geo tagging and metadata can support image organization and local SEO workflows, but they do not guarantee Google rankings.
